text: Traditional founding of the city of Rome by Romulus
The Roman Republic was established after the overthrow of the monarchy
The First Punic War began between Rome and Carthage
Julius Caesar was assassinated in the Senate
Augustus became Rome's first emperor, founding the Roman Empire
The Colosseum was completed in Rome
The Roman Empire reached its greatest territorial extent under Trajan
Emperor Constantine issued the Edict of Milan, legalizing Christianity
The Roman Empire split permanently into Western and Eastern halves
The Western Roman Empire fell when Romulus Augustulus was deposed by Odoacer
